Metadata.title: Automotive Styling Studio
Metadata.description: A cinematic automotive vinyl wrapping and styling studio experience in Baku, Azerbaijan.

statement.body: Every surface changes how a vehicle is read. We approach vinyl as a deliberate design decision — considered in material, proportion and finish.

projects.heading: The right solution for every surface.
projects.intro: Our services are shown with real Unsplash photography. See our own work on Instagram.

instagram.heading: The latest work lives on Instagram.
instagram.body: Explore new projects, application process and close-up details directly on our Instagram profile.

services.heading: Complete automotive care.
services.note: We recommend the right service for the vehicle's condition and the result you want.

items.title: XPEL / Llumar PPF
items.description: Clear or matte paint protection film against stone chips, light scratches and everyday wear.

items.title: Vinyl wrapping
items.description: A full or partial colour and style transformation without altering the factory paint.

items.title: Polishing
items.description: Professional treatment that reduces light defects and restores gloss to the clear coat.

items.title: Ceramic coating
items.description: Added gloss, hydrophobic performance and surface protection against everyday contamination.

items.title: Interior deep cleaning
items.description: Deep cleaning of seats, flooring and interior surfaces using material-appropriate products.

items.title: Paintwork
items.description: Local or complete restoration of damaged panels with accurate colour matching.

items.title: Vehicle branding
items.description: Design and application of logos, graphics and advertising vinyl for commercial vehicles.

about.heading: Precision is the aesthetic.
about.body: VINIL DESIGN is an automotive vinyl and styling studio based in Baku. The studio is built around a focused idea: every transformation should feel coherent with the vehicle, not applied on top of it.
about.imageAlt: A specialist working on a car in a detailing studio

process.heading: Considered from first look to final line.

items.title: Consultation
items.description: We align on the vehicle, intended character and material direction.

items.title: Preparation
items.description: Surfaces and details are prepared for a controlled application.

items.title: Application
items.description: Vinyl is applied with attention to edges, tension and continuity.

items.title: Final inspection
items.description: The complete finish is reviewed before handover.
